reason: A DSH plugin for monitoring Volcengine Ark Coding Plan and Agent Plan quotas through the official API, with periodic refresh, threshold warnings, and floating visualizations.

summaries.zh: 通过火山方舟官方 API 实时查看 Coding Plan 和 Agent Plan 的额度使用、剩余量与重置倒计时，并在悬浮面板中显示告警。
summaries.en: Monitors Volcengine Ark Coding Plan and Agent Plan quotas through the official API, showing usage, remaining capacity, reset timers, and threshold alerts in a floating panel.

capabilities: Calls the Volcengine Ark official API to retrieve Coding Plan or Agent Plan quota usage
Stores and reads AK/SK credentials through the DSH credential service or environment variables
Displays quota usage, remaining amounts, reset timers, and threshold warnings in a floating UI
Automatically refreshes quota data every 60 seconds
